items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I went to see Jimmy Blanton once... I said, 'Duke, you got to get up and come with me and let's go and see this bass player, to go and hear him.'

ctx.x: It sure is. How about Jimmy Blanton?
Blanton? Oh, he was a great musician.

Jimmy Blanton -- I went to see him, we was in St. Louis, and I went to see Jimmy Blanton once, because he was a fellow who used to take his bass and play with anybody, you know? In this particular cabaret, I went there and listened to him, and he was playing Sophisticated Lady with a bow, you know?
